“For, behold, the day comes, it burns as a furnace; and all the proud, and all who work wickedness, will be stubble…

translations.web: His roots will be dried up beneath. His branch will be cut off above.
translations.bsb: The roots beneath him dry up, and the branches above him wither away.
translations.kjv: His roots shall be dried up beneath, and above shall his branch be cut off.
translations.asv: His roots shall be dried up beneath, And above shall his branch be cut off.
